name: Classic
description: The baseline single-column ATS-safe layout: black section rules, default serif font, standard spacing. The reference design every other template in this set is built from.

name: Navy Accent
description: Classic layout with navy blue section rules and name for a subtle professional accent color.

name: Charcoal & Teal
description: Charcoal body text with teal section rules and name for a softer, modern contrast.

name: Maroon Academic
description: Charter serif font with a maroon accent, suited to academic and research-oriented resumes.

name: Sans Modern
description: Source Sans Pro sans-serif with black rules for a clean, contemporary tech-resume look.

name: Sans Blue
description: Roboto sans-serif with a blue accent, a popular choice for engineering and product roles.

name: Garamond Elegant
description: Cormorant Garamond serif, a thin gray rule, and extra spacing for an elegant, editorial feel.

name: Compact Dense
description: Classic layout with tightened vertical spacing to fit more content on a single page.

name: Spacious Clean
description: Extra breathing room and a thin minimalist rule, best for resumes with less content.

name: Double Rule
description: Two closely-stacked thin rules below each section heading for a bit more visual structure.

name: Left Bar Sections
description: Section headings marked with a small indigo bar instead of a full-width rule.

name: Icon-Free Max ATS
description: No FontAwesome icons anywhere and plain-text contact labels, for maximum compatibility with ATS parsers that mishandle symbol fonts.

name: Single Line Header
description: Contact details compressed onto one line beneath the name with a forest-green divider rule, saving vertical space.

name: Education First (Student)
description: Same design, reordered to lead with Education, for students and new graduates.

name: Projects First (Engineer)
description: Same design, reordered to put Projects right after Experience, for engineers who want projects prominent.

name: Skills First (Career Changer)
description: Same design, reordered to lead with Technical Skills, for career changers foregrounding transferable skills.

name: Consolidated Additional Info
description: Profile Links and Achievements merged into one Additional Information section with compact spacing, for one-page-constrained resumes.

name: Bold Header Banner
description: Larger bold name with a thick divider rule and heavier section rules for a confident, executive presentation.
